Gang: Dan Jaffe with the ANA just called relative to two potential battles on tobacco advertising deductibility:
1. a bill by Boxer, Chaffee, and Reed denying deductibility for tobacco advertising unless we sign/adhere to the consent decrees, and
2. in the Senate Finance Cmtc., Dan says the IRS Rcorganization Act needs money, and they might look at tobacco ad deductibility as a source of revenue.
FYI. Let me know if you pick up any movement on the above. Murray
